pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with semi-sharp edge gradients. Geometric complexity varies from simple quadrilateral forms to complex multi-edged shapes with varying degrees of interior pixel intensity.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of cream-colored paths with high connectivity. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial intersections. Path thickness is relatively narrow, approximately 10-15% of the width of adjacent dark patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible short-haired mane with low-amplitude and high-frequency jagged silhouette along the cervical dorsal line.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Localized region of textural disruption and de-pigmentation (grayish-blue tint) visible on the mid-upper flank, where patch definition is softened.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct horizontal linear disruption is visible across two dark patches in the mid-flank region, suggestive of a physical scar.
